verdict.rationale: x402 replaces raw card numbers with signed per-request payment authorizations. The 'upto' scheme lets a buyer authorize a maximum and settle only what was used, and batch settlement commits escrowed funds where 'limits are cryptographically signed' with refund and withdrawal semantics. Agentic Wallets give an agent its own fund source, but no evidence shows user-configurable spending limits, expiry, or merchant restrictions on the credential given to the agent. missing for 10: user-set amount caps on the agent's wallet or credential, credential expiry controls, merchant/payee allowlists, independent or hands-on corroboration of scoped delegation
